# SMAA

[SMAA](https://github.com/iryoku/smaa) (Enhanced Subpixel Morphological Antialiasing) by Jorge Jimenez, Jose I. Echevarria,
Belen Masia, Fernando Navarro and Diego Gutierrez, MIT licence (LICENSE.txt), from its repository's master (71c806a, 2013):
SMAA.hlsl (the shader, compiled as GLSL 3.30 with `SMAA_GLSL_3`), Textures/AreaTex.h and Textures/SearchTex.h (its two
precomputed textures). The files are as published but for their line endings (LF). The anti-aliasing option's SMAA choice
uses them (src/platform/native/graphics/smaa.cpp).
